statement: RunPod's published on-demand Secure Cloud rates as of 2026-08-11: H100 SXM $2.99 per GPU-hour, B200 $5.89, H200 $4.39, B300 $7.39, A100 SXM $1.49 — materially below Lambda's same-day rates for the same GPU classes.
why: These are list rental levels for data-center accelerators with no stated prior price or change on the page, so they read as a static price level and a same-day cross-provider spread rather than a directional move.

impact.mechanism: Published per-hour rates set what renters pay for NVIDIA accelerator time, tying neocloud pricing to the economics of owning merchant-GPU hardware; absent a baseline the level implies no direction.

evidence.excerpt: H100 NVL $3.19/hr (Secure Cloud); H100 PCIe $2.89/hr (Secure Cloud); H100 SXM $2.99/hr (Secure Cloud)
B300 $7.39/hr (Secure Cloud); H200 $4.39/hr (Secure Cloud); B200 $5.89/hr (Secure Cloud)

confidence.basis: Vendor's own list page (secondary tier), one publisher; Community Cloud rates were not broken out in the fetched text.

dispersion: Wide same-day spread between providers for identical GPU classes: H100 SXM $2.99/hr at RunPod versus $3.99-$4.29/hr at Lambda; B200 $5.89/hr versus $6.69-$6.99/hr at Lambda.
